    Closed classes of bounded length are everything #

    A class 𝒦 of nonzero indecomposables, closed under isomorphism, containing the summands of the chosen minimal right almost split maps into its members, with left almost split families inside 𝒦, and of bounded dimension, contains every nonzero indecomposable when A is connected (all_of_closed). Connected means: for a complete set of orthogonal idempotents e x, every nonempty set of points closed under e x A e y ≠ 0 in both directions is everything.
